name: red.quart.screen-framework
description:
Layered screen navigation for Unity UI: page / dialog stacks, transition effects, and presenters that can be driven without a scene.

UniTask is a required dependency but cannot be declared here (it is distributed as a git package). Add it to the consuming project's manifest:
  "com.cysharp.unitask": "https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask.git?path=src/UniTask/Assets/Plugins/UniTask"
